title: Rheumatologist Perceptions of Advanced Therapies in Moderate-to-Severe Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Thank you for participating. This survey takes approximately 10 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.
completedHtml:
Thank you for completing the survey.

Your responses have been recorded.

elements.name: S1
elements.title: S1. Which of the following best describes your primary clinical role?

elements.name: S2
elements.title: S2. How many years have you been treating patients with rheumatoid arthritis?
elements.description: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.

elements.name: Q1
elements.title: Q1. Which of the following advanced therapies for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis are you aware of?

elements.name: Q2
elements.title: Q2. What is your most important consideration when selecting an advanced therapy for moderate-to-severe RA?

elements.name: Q3
elements.title: Q3. Which advanced therapy do you prescribe most often for moderate-to-severe RA?

elements.name: Q4
elements.title: Q4. How satisfied are you with {Q3brand} for your moderate-to-severe RA patients?

elements.name: Q5
elements.title: Q5. Please rate your agreement with each of the following statements.
rows: Advanced therapies have transformed outcomes in rheumatoid arthritis
Prior authorization requirements delay my patients' treatment
I am comfortable prescribing JAK inhibitors given current safety guidance

elements.name: Q6
elements.title: Q5. What percentage of your moderate-to-severe RA patients currently receive an advanced therapy (biologic or JAK inhibitor)?
elements.description: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

elements.name: Q8
elements.title: Q8. How likely are you you to recommend advanced therapy to a colleague treating moderate-to-severe RA?
elements.description: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
